verdict.rationale: Sales Cloud's pricing page says it automatically syncs events, which covers the calendar-sync part of the story. That claim is a single headline line with no supporting docs, and nothing in the evidence shows synced meetings appearing on contact or opportunity (deal) timelines. Missing for 10: documentation of calendar provider support, evidence that synced meetings appear on contact and deal timelines, sync configuration details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can sync my calendar so meetings appear on contact and deal timelines

citations.quote: AI Automatically Syncs Emails, Events, and Contacts
